Asian Steak
By: Anonymous
Published: Monday, November 30, 2009 - 11:11pm

Ingredients




1/2 cup Wish-Bone Italian dressing
1/2 teaspoon Ground ginger, (optional)
2 tablespoons Firmly packed brown sugar
2 tablespoons Soy sauce
1 pound Flank, top round or sirloin steak (up to 1-½)

Preparation

1 In shallow dish, combine all ingredients except steak. Add steak, turn to coat. Cover marinate in refrigerator 3 to 24 hours. Remove steak, reserving marindade. Grill or broil until steak is done. Boil reserved marinade, pour over steak. 2 Makes 6 servings.
